subject: Revenue assertion & runway scrub: evidence and deal origins
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Revenue assertion & runway scrub: evidence and deal origins

Team —

We need a rapid, evidence-first sweep for CloudScale (DEAL-8392) ahead of the investor packet. Primary asks:

1) Confirm ARR math and billing cadence for the Q4 booking we plan to assert (is this recognized as 12 months ARR or a one-time professional-service uplift?).
2) Reconcile the deal journal rows in HubSpot with finance records (I attached a lightweight CSV extract).
3) For any deals we are calling 'commit' in the corridor, include a 1-line origin note (source, rep, key milestone) and attach the SOW/PO where available.

I've dropped a starter evidence pack (Q3-evidence-pack.xlsx) with three tabs: revenue-assertion, deal-journal-snapshot, and required-docs. Please:
- Vanessa: can you lead the billing cadence confirmation and mark any revenue that should be de-risked for ARR?
- Karthik: quick origin notes column and legal/contract status (signed/awaiting countersign).
- Grace: once we have the settled table, can you slot the rows into the board appendix format and sanity-check the ARR math?

Timeline: I'd like a first pass by EOD 08/03 (today) and final evidence pinned by 12:00pm PT 08/04 for the packet.

Attachments: Q3-evidence-pack.xlsx, deal-journal-8392.csv

Thanks —
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0123

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revenue assertion & runway scrub: evidence and deal origins

Mateo —

Quick update from billing/ops after a 30-minute run:

- ARR treatment: CloudScale contract is annual SaaS with a one-time integration fee. The CX team priced it as 12-month ARR (recurring ARR = $420,000). Integration fee ($35,000) is professional services and should be excluded from ARR; it will be recognized as one-time booking.
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices net-30; first invoice hits 09/01, which aligns with our revenue recognition calendar for FY28 Q1.
- Exceptions: There is an unpublished credit note tied to pre-sales discounts that reduces booked value by $12,000; I flagged it in the attached CSV.

I populated the Q3-evidence-pack in the "revenue-assertion" tab with the corrected ARR line, and added a new column: de-risk_flag (low|medium|high). CloudScale currently = medium due to pending DocuSign from their procurement.

Next steps: I will escalate the DocuSign ping to their contracts contact; if we get signed before 12:00pm PT 08/04, we can include the full ARR in the board appendix.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revenue assertion & runway scrub: evidence and deal origins

Thanks — I added the deal-origin column and short journal notes in deal-journal-8392.csv:
- Origin: Outbound pipeline (AE: Rachel Thompson)
- Key milestone: SOW signed by CloudScale product lead 07/28; countersign awaited from procurement.
- Risk call: medium (procurement delay + discount note).

Also linked HubSpot record 6789 in the evidence pack and included the rep-playbook excerpt that documents the discount approval path.

I'll stand by for the DocuSign status and will mark the row as "board-ready" only if the SOW is countersigned.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Deal Operations | Redwood Inference

Hi Mateo / Vanessa —

Apologies for the delay. Procurement required a short legal review; we've just routed the SOW for countersign and Contracts expects to complete by tomorrow morning PT. Attaching the redline summary and confirming Marco Li on the VC side asked for an invoice copy for his records.

Attachments: SOW-CloudScale-signed.pdf (signed by product lead), SOW-redline-summary.pdf

We are committed to the 09/01 start date. If you need a PO ahead of signature we can provisionally share a PO reference.

Grace —

Forwarding final confirmations from CloudScale. Their Contracts team says countersign tomorrow morning; Rachel attached the signed SOW from the product lead. Vanessa, please reconcile the $12k credit note and drop final ARR line in the board appendix format (see attach). Karthik, once we have countersign, mark DEAL-8392 as "committed" in HubSpot and push the HubSpot snapshot to the board appendix folder.

I also pulled Marco Li's request for an invoice copy — if we can provide a provisional invoice today, it increases the likelihood procurement finishes on time.

I'll compile the final evidence pack (with the SOW and invoice stub) by 12:00pm PT for the board packet. If anything blocks, call me.
